Four-bit output deliberately uses the first unpadded digit, including for low channels.
Rust requires u8 RGB channels; out-of-domain JavaScript calls and future browser binding conversion are documented limitations, not silently claimed coverage.
No unsafe code or additional dependency in the reviewed implementation.
